figures.caption: Fig. 4 Binding energy shifts (ΔBE) during the ﬁrst charge to 5.0 V and open-circuit relaxation. ΔBE of a, the current collector and electrolyte, a-1 Al 1s, a-2 P 1s, and b the cathode, b-1 Li 1s, and b-2 O 1s peaks, relative to the Fermi energy of Li during Al cathode-grounded operando hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES). Considering the behaviors of the peak shifts in Li 1s and O 1s, the ﬁrst charge process can be divided into four stages: stage 1, 2.8 V to 3.25 V (0 ≤x < 0.04 in Li2−xMnO3); stage 2, 3.25 V to 4.38 V (0.04 ≤x < 0.27); stage 3, 4.38 V to 4.65 V (0.27 ≤x < 0.63); and stage 4, 4.65 V to 5.0 V (0.63 ≤x < 1.0). The time scale differs between the charging and open-circuit modes.
